title: mayaCharts spec
description: A mayaCharts chart spec: plain JSON, no functions. Core types need no import; module types (treemap, sunburst, marimekko, waffle, sankey, chord, radial, gauge, hexmap, boxplot, funnel, weave, units, orbit, constellation) need their module or maya.<module>.global.js. Full reference: https://bbekshr.github.io/mayacharts/docs.html

$schema.description: Ignored; lets editors and LLMs find the JSON schema.

type.description: Chart type. ridgeline, beeswarm, parallel, table are core. treemap, sunburst, marimekko, waffle need `mayacharts/hierarchy`; sankey, chord need `mayacharts/flow`; radial and gauge need `mayacharts/radial`; hexmap needs `mayacharts/geo`; boxplot, funnel need `mayacharts/stats`; weave, units, orbit and constellation each need the module of the same name (`mayacharts/weave` and so on).

oneOf.description: Keyed by y field, with a y array that toggles the measure.

aggregate.description: How rows sharing a (category, series) combine. `count` counts non-null y. { ratio: [numerator, denominator] } sums both fields per group and divides (zero denominator: null), at every drill level, in Other and in "mean" rules; y then only names the measure and need not be in the rows; other fields sum. Ratio: bar line area heatmap dumbbell table kpi gauge hexmap; not with stack or was. With a y array that toggles the measure, key it by y field: { price: { ratio: ["sales", "units"] } }; unlisted fields sum.

sort.description: Order categories by total across all series (hidden ones too). bar line area heatmap dumbbell table radial waffle orbit.

limit.description: Keep the top N categories by total; the rest roll up into a final "Other". A bar with more categories than fit (past 10000 marks) does this on its own when limit is unset, and says so in `warnings`. bar line area heatmap dumbbell table radial waffle orbit.

x.description: Category field (scatter: numeric x; hexmap: US state; boxplot: one box each; funnel: the stage, omitted when `y` lists the stages). Not used by path types.

xType.description: How x is spaced. "auto": a time axis when every x is an ISO 8601 date ("2024-03" or longer) on line, area or vertical bar without sort or limit; else categories. "time" also accepts epoch ms numbers.

oneOf.description: An array adds a measure toggle, first one active (parallel: one axis each; table: one column each; funnel without `x`: one stage each, its rows combined by `aggregate`; kpi: one tile each; gauge: one field only).

y2.description: Second value field, drawn as a line on a right axis over the bars (vertical bar only); orbit: growth, which sets each planet's speed and direction. bar orbit.

was.description: Previous value field: a ghost bar at the old value over each bar (dashed, keyed in the legend), "was" in the tooltip, a data table column and a description sentence naming the 2 largest relative moves (kpi: a second comparison, e.g. same period last year; gauge: a marker at the old value). Long data: { by } names the period field; the latest distinct value is current and the one before it previous (ISO dates and epoch ms sort as time, else data order), other periods are dropped, and the ghosts are titled by the previous period. current and previous pick periods explicitly. bar kpi gauge; not with stack or a y array.

forms.description: Forms a units chart switches between, first one shown (view.form picks another); the element adds a form control when there are 2 or more. Default all three. units only.

frame.description: Playback: one frame per distinct value of this field (data order). Shows one frame, the last by default, names it in the title, and the element adds a Play button. Value axes span every frame. Values match as strings (1 and "1" are one frame); null rows belong to none; at most 200 frames. bar line area scatter dumbbell.

series.description: Splits rows into series (heatmap: the row category; dumbbell: exactly two, from and to; ridgeline: one row each; marimekko: the segments; radial: stacked outward; boxplot: boxes side by side; weave: one thread each, required; constellation: colours the stars by group). bar line area scatter heatmap dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel marimekko radial boxplot weave constellation.

path.description: Hierarchy fields, outer to inner. treemap sunburst sankey chord; bar line area dumbbell table marimekko with drill (replaces x); heatmap with drill (replaces series, the rows).

depth.description: Levels drawn at once below the current branch, each parent holding its children under a name strip; a click drills into the parent under the pointer. Default: 1 with drill, every level without. treemap only.

minAngle.description: Sunburst slices narrower than this many degrees fold into one "Other (n)" slice per ring (the largest sibling never folds). 0 folds nothing. Default: slices under 4 px across fold. sunburst only.

size.description: Bubble area field (sqrt scale). scatter constellation.

name.description: Point identity and tooltip title (units: one dot per row). scatter, beeswarm, boxplot (outliers and dots) and units.

totals.description: x values drawn as running-total bars. waterfall only.

stack.description: Stack series instead of grouping them; "percent" shows each category's visible values as shares of its total, axis 0 to 100% (with negatives: shares of the summed magnitudes, below 0). bar and area only.

horizontal.description: Categories on the left axis. bar and dumbbell.

oneOf.description: A preset / template / Intl options per field. Display only.

format.description: Display format for values: a preset for every y, a template, or per field a preset, template or Intl options plus prefix and suffix text. Example: {gap: {maximumFractionDigits: 1, signDisplay: "exceptZero", suffix: " pts"}}.

titles.description: Display names by field: axis titles (shown only when set), tooltip, legend, table.

labels.description: Formatted values on marks. Default false (heatmap: true when cells are ≥ 24 px).

title.description: Visible heading, also the accessible name. Data tokens: {max.x} {max.y} {min.x} {min.y} {first.x} {first.y} {last.x} {last.y} {total} {mean}, formatted by format. Without a selector max, min, first and last read one drawn point (stacked: category totals) and total sums every series; a series selector such as {last.y:2025} or {total:2025} reads only that series. Scatter: max and min by y, first and last by x, .x the x value or name. With no rows a title holding a token is dropped. In an element under 200 px tall it is one line with an ellipsis. Only these exact names are replaced; any other brace text stays as written.

subtitle.description: Second line under the title, smaller and muted; takes the same data tokens as title; hidden in an element under 200 px tall. Not in the bare render() SVG.

yDomain.description: Fixed value-axis domain (kpi: the bullet scale; gauge: the dial range). Not allowed with a `y` array.

rules.description: Reference lines (at most 4): a number or "mean" across the value axis (mean of the visible values; stacked: of the category totals), { x } across the category axis at that x, { band: [lo, hi] } a shaded value range; each optionally labelled. Scatter also takes { slope, intercept? }: y = slope * x + intercept, slope "mean" = sum of y / sum of x, labelled with its value as y per x (text.perX), clear of the points. [] is the same as unset. bar line area scatter dumbbell.

yScale.description: Log value axis (ticks at powers of 10); every plotted value must be above 0. line scatter (a bar encodes its value as length from zero, so bar, waterfall and area refuse it).

xScale.description: Log x axis; every x must be above 0. scatter only.

annotate.description: Label these points of each visible series with their value: max, min, first, last (scatter: max and min by y, first and last by x); { x, text } labels the mark at that x with the text. bar line area scatter. [] is the same as unset.

dash.description: Series values drawn dashed (line, the area outline). line area; needs series. [] is the same as unset.

tooltip.description: Hover/keyboard tooltip. { fields } adds those fields as tooltip rows and data table columns, formatted by format; bar, line and area combine numeric fields by aggregate. fields: bar line area scatter.

legend.description: Legend; clicking toggles series. "top", "bottom" or "right" places it (true is "top"). Default: true when `series` is set, and for waffle, hexmap and units (toggles groups).

endLabels.description: Line and area: name each series at its right end and drop the legend (legend: true keeps it).

drill.description: Click/Enter zooms into a branch of `path`; breadcrumb, Back and Escape pop. With select too, click/Enter selects and double-click/Shift+Enter drills. At the last level the drill gesture fires maya-drill-leaf. Sankey: any node but the last column. treemap sunburst sankey chord; bar line area dumbbell table heatmap marimekko with path.

drillOut.description: With `drill`: a click on empty chart space goes back up one level. Default true.

select.description: Click/Enter/legend selects marks, others dim; Escape clears. With `drill`, double-click/Shift+Enter drills. bar line area waterfall scatter heatmap dumbbell beeswarm parallel table marimekko waffle radial treemap sunburst hexmap boxplot funnel weave units orbit constellation.

zoom.description: Drag to zoom. line, area, scatter. Reset chip, double-click and Escape restore.

animate.description: Animate the first draw and every update (element only; off under reduced motion).

oneOf.description: Palette in series order (at most 8 distinct colours).
Colours by series value (treemap, sunburst: by path[0] value; sankey, chord: by node name; waffle: by category), any number of keys.

colors.description: Palette in series order, or colours by name (a name beats theme series1..8, which beat the array): series value; treemap and sunburst path[0] value; sankey and chord node name (links and inner levels inherit); waffle category. Unmatched keys are ignored. Path types keep each name colour through drill. A sankey root missing from a map stays neutral at every drill level.

anyOf.description: kpi with a y array: thresholds keyed by y field.

colorBy.description: Tone by sign of y, by a target (good at or past it; better "lower" flips it), or a ramp by a numeric field. Not with `series`. Types other than kpi and gauge need target and take no warn; kpi and gauge take any of target, warn and better, warn needs target and sits on the bad side of it. bar line area waterfall scatter dumbbell kpi gauge treemap sunburst hexmap units orbit constellation.

grid.description: Grid lines perpendicular to the value axis.

table.description: Visually hidden data table for screen readers.

goal.description: Thresholds: target, warn on the bad side of target (kpi and gauge), better "higher" (default) or "lower".
